Cells on one line:

{|
! Feature !! Page !! Notes
|-
| '''Parser''' || [[Main Page|Home]] || All ''four'' formats
|-
| Docs || [https://example.com/docs external] || <s>struck</s> and <code>code</code>
|}

One cell per line:

{|
|-
! A
! B
! C
|-
| 1
| 2
| 3
|}

Without a header row:

{|
| 1 || 2
|-
| 3 || 4
|}

Uneven rows become HTML:

{|
! A !! B
|-
| 1 || 2
|-
| only one cell
|}

With a caption, attributes and a cell over two columns:

{| class="wikitable" style="width: 100%"
|+ Distances
! scope="col" | Day !! Distance
|-
| style="text-align: right" | 1 || 14 km
|-
| colspan="2" | Rest day
|}

| 1 || 2
